scope: Independent change review, persistence execution and catalogue scheduling execution. This is not full-system release or hardware certification.

independentExecutedTests.method: Production Choices/load/save compiled and run with ASan/UBSan; Preferences is an in-memory fault-injectable boundary.
verified: v1 preserved by explicit v2 save
Malformed/truncated/duplicate preferences rejected without partial application

independentExecutedTests.method: Production serviceHomeApps extracted verbatim and production Schedule executed with ASan/UBSan; scanner, storage, render and clock boundaries simulated.
verified: No catalogue scan or redraw during two simulated minutes of cache mutations on native home, with or without external shortcuts
One startup discovery for external shortcuts
Absent support without retry loop; SD/USB support changes rediscover
Cancellation on other page or Tools; resume on return
Disabled dock does not scan; sidebar settings can discover outside home

codeInspection.conclusion: v1 blob remains intact; validated v2 blob uses stable 64-bit catalogue keys; no migration auto-write.

Activation resolves the persisted key against the current table and passes a copied App to the shared launcher; staged catalogue publication does not mutate the visible table during enumeration. Missing support does not erase configured keys.

Capacity is 10 for the 672 px content height; buttons are 56 px, bounds and spacing fit; the dock itself is not scrollable. Picker keys have LVGL DELETE cleanup; refresh clears old focus before deleting children.
Focused application is restored by stable key after catalogue publication; hadFocus permits fallback if the row disappears. Recreated controls do not retain stale catalogue indices.

Explicit requests override USB-keyboard suppression while automatic opening preserves it; target deletion and app close clear the keyboard; existing resize hook is retained. No new PIN/message persistence or logging was introduced by this hook.

Viewer and Drawing quick actions dispatch distinct existing FileCommand cases. Existing T5I viewing composes project layers. Context menu selection styling follows pointer hover independently from keyboard focus; image selection/double-click routing was not replaced by the quick actions.

Lazy index placement construction/destruction and close/relayout ownership are coherent. Double allocation failure is represented explicitly and service does not retry each loop. JPEG and tuner changes make read-only data const without changing table values or algorithms.

reviewFindingsResolved.finding: The intermediate picker used a catalogue index and failed to restore keyboard focus after catalogue republication.
reviewFindingsResolved.resolution: Final picker binds a stable 64-bit key with DELETE cleanup; refresh tracks hadFocus and restores the matching key or a valid fallback.
reviewFindingsResolved.verification: Final source inspection plus final peer real-LVGL dock suite; stable-key focus restoration is executed there.

reviewFindingsResolved.finding: createDock executes before built-in catalogue construction.
reviewFindingsResolved.resolution: createHomePage now explicitly calls shellCatalogueChanged after registering built-ins and rendering.
reviewFindingsResolved.verification: Final initialization order inspected; no claim of a physical boot measurement.

reviewFindingsResolved.finding: Refreshing a focused external shortcut after media removal could restore focus onto its disabled replacement.
reviewFindingsResolved.resolution: Use focusInitial(dock, candidate) to filter disabled/hidden controls and choose a valid fallback.
reviewFindingsResolved.verification: Final source inspection and peer real-LVGL assertions for focus, Tab and Enter after removal.

designConstraintVerified: Global tab5FsRevision also reflects map/media cache writes. It is observed but cannot trigger a scan by itself on the idle native home; only visible catalogues use its debounce/poll scheduling.
remainingValidation: Full target link is an independent release gate owned by the build agent; this review does not claim its completion. Final dock real-LVGL integration evidence has passed and is linked above.
On Tab5: migrate existing sidebar preferences, restart, exercise 10 native/ELF/Python shortcuts, remove/reinsert media, verify mouse and keyboard navigation and no idle refresh.
On Tab5: Meshtastic keyboard with USB attached/detached, Enter to send and PIN input, then close/reopen; Bluetooth and radio behavior require hardware.
On Tab5: inspect SRAM free/minimum/largest block before/after repeated eBook opens; object/link changes are not runtime heap measurements.
limitations: No physical Tab5, real SD/NVS, BLE, DMA or display timing was exercised by this reviewer.
Code inspection is distinguished from executed tests. I/O/task/graphics boundaries in the scheduling fixture are simulated; NVS power-loss atomicity is not inferred from the Preferences fixture.
AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer were enabled for the two independent fixtures; LeakSanitizer was disabled because this host cannot inspect its process tasks.
The existing global catalogue retains its maximum of 64 entries and reports truncation; the sidebar limit of 10 is the visible no-scroll capacity. No application isolation claim is made.

finalDeltaInspection.method: Read final sources, compare against previously reviewed source hashes, inspect relevant LVGL callback registration failure semantics, inspect two actual host-rendered captures.
conclusions: Caption writes are bounded by the 16-byte destination, accepts at most three complete UTF-8 code points, measures their width using the UI font and uses a clip label; the full title remains available in the description.
Picker labels have explicit one-line height and 990-pixel width to prevent wrapping.
Failed picker key allocation reports the existing memory error. Failed callback registration releases the key and deletes the unregistered button, clearing a proposed focus target before deletion.
Dock refresh uses focusInitial, which excludes the disabled shortcut when its app disappears; final real-LVGL peer suite exercises Tab/Enter after removal.
Persistence and scheduler source hashes did not change, so their existing executed results remain applicable without relabeling or unnecessary reruns.

visualInspection.observations: Ten targets fit the available height without a scrollbar; external fallback prefixes Mor/Hor are readable and native icons remain separate.
Picker rows remain one line inside the popup; labels and selected control use the configured dark-theme colors.
